heading: About {name}
description: Music from building blocks: stack sounds, rhythms and effects like on a mixing desk – strudelmixr turns them into Strudel code live.
author: Author
openSource: strudelmixr is built on great open-source projects. Thanks to everyone who contributes to them!

purposes.strudel: Live-coding music in the browser – the heart of strudelmixr
purposes.strudelCore: Patterns, mini-notation and running the generated code
purposes.strudelWebaudio: Sound generation, effects and sample playback (Web Audio)
purposes.strudelWeb: Embedding Strudel in your own pages
purposes.tidalCycles: The model for Strudel's pattern language and mini-notation
purposes.acorn: Parsing and rewriting the Strudel code
purposes.react: Interactive islands: mixer, inspector, code view
purposes.nanostores: State and event bus between the islands
purposes.codemirror: Code editor with highlighting, search and autocompletion
purposes.uzuDrumkit: Drum kit “Modern” and the default drums – only the files by Switch Angel
purposes.freepats: Drum kit “Analog” (Roberto, zenvoid.org – synthesized with Yoshimi and Geonkick)
purposes.hydrogen808: Drum kit “808” (ArtemioLabs – synthesized from sine waves and noise)
purposes.salamander: Piano sound – Alexander Holm, a selection as MP3 via Tone.js
purposes.sonicPi: Sample library: tabla, electro, percussion, glitch, bass, ambient, vinyl
purposes.astro: Web framework with SSR and islands (@astrojs/node, @astrojs/react)
purposes.vitest: Tests – the generated code is checked by real Strudel
purposes.strudelExtras: Microtonal tunings, MIDI in/out, device sensors and Csound – loaded only when code uses them
purposes.csound: Csound sound engine for csound() code – loaded only on first use
